import numpy as np\n\
import pandas as pd\n\
\n\
def calculate_msd(dump_file, output_file):\n\
    data = pd.read_csv(dump_file, delim_whitespace=True, header=None, skiprows=9)\n\
    data.columns = ['id', 'type', 'x', 'y', 'z']\n\
    msd = []\n\
    time_steps = len(data) // len(data['id'].unique())\n\
    for t in range(time_steps):\n\
        subset = data.iloc[t::time_steps]\n\
        displacements = (subset[['x', 'y', 'z']] - subset[['x', 'y', 'z']].iloc[0]) ** 2\n\
        msd.append(displacements.sum(axis=1).mean())\n\
    times = np.arange(0, time_steps) * 0.001  # assuming 1 fs timestep\n\
    msd_data = pd.DataFrame({'time': times, 'msd': msd})\n\
    msd_data.to_csv(output_file, index=False, sep=' ')\n\
\n\
calculate_msd('dump.equilibration', 'msd.dat')\n"
}</action_input>
